# Security policy

This is a static personal website with no user accounts, forms or server-side code, so the attack surface is small. If you still find a vulnerability, in the site or in its build and deploy setup, please report it privately.

## Reporting

Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/paroose/website/security/advisories/new). Please don't open a public issue for a security problem.

I'll reply as soon as I can. This is a hobby project, so there's no guaranteed response time.

## Supported versions

Only the latest version on `main`, which is what's deployed to <https://paroose.dev>.
